title: feat: Integrate better-auth library into authentication plugin
body:
Integrates better-auth v1.4.18 as the authentication engine for `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, replacing stub implementations with a production-ready foundation.

## Changes

### Core Integration
- **AuthManager wrapper class** with lazy initialization pattern - defers better-auth instantiation until first use to avoid database initialization failures in test environments
- **Type-safe HTTP handlers** using `IHttpRequest`/`IHttpResponse` from `@objectstack/core`
- **Method structures** for login, register, logout, session management, email verification, and password reset (API wiring pending)

### Security & Configuration
- Environment-based secret management with runtime warnings when `AUTH_SECRET` is missing
- Removed hardcoded database adapter dependency - configuration now warns when `databaseUrl` is provided without drizzle-orm
- Dynamic secret generation for development: `dev-secret-${timestamp}`

### Architecture
```typescript
export class AuthManager {
  private auth: Auth<any> | null = null;  // Lazy init
  
  private getOrCreateAuth(): Auth<any> {
    if (!this.auth) {
      this.auth = betterAuth({
        secret: this.config.secret || this.generateSecret(),
        baseURL: this.config.baseUrl || 'http://localhost:3000',
        database: this.createDatabaseConfig(),
        emailAndPassword: { enabled: true },
        session: {
          expiresIn: this.config.session?.expiresIn || 604800,
          updateAge: this.config.session?.updateAge || 86400,
        },
      });
    }
    return this.auth;
  }
}
```

## Next Steps
- Wire better-auth API methods to route handlers
- Implement drizzle-orm database adapter
- Add OAuth provider configurations (Google, GitHub)
- Enable advanced features (2FA, passkeys, magic links)
